name: OCI ZPR Visibility
description: Dashboard query catalog for OCI ZPR posture, policy inventory, protected resources, allow/block traffic, and governance findings.

widgets.name: KPI: Active policies
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats distinctcount(policy_id) as policies

widgets.name: KPI: Protected resources
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats distinctcount(resource_id) as resources

widgets.name: KPI: Critical+High findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and severity in ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH') | eval fk = finding_type || '|' || policy_name || '|' || cidr || '|' || resource_name || '|' || attribute_reference | stats distinctcount(fk) as high_findings
ask_ai_prompts: List the open CRITICAL and HIGH findings and their resources.

widgets.name: KPI: Flow Log REJECT tuples
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' | eval fk = source_ip || '|' || destination_ip || '|' || destination_port || '|' || protocol | stats distinctcount(fk) as rejected_flow_tuples
widgets.description: Distinct source/destination/port/protocol tuples recorded with Flow Log action REJECT in the selected window. This is not a ZPR verdict.

widgets.name: KPI: Accepted for policy review
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and review_classification = 'accepted_requires_policy_review' | eval fk = source_ip || '|' || destination_ip || '|' || destination_port || '|' || protocol | stats distinctcount(fk) as accepted_for_review

widgets.name: Active ZPR policies
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats latest(policy_lifecycle_state) as current_policy_lifecycle_state by policy_id | where current_policy_lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' | stats count as active_policies

widgets.name: Protected resources
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats distinctcount(resource_id) as protected_resources by resource_type

widgets.name: Top findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' | eval fk = finding_type || '|' || policy_name || '|' || cidr || '|' || resource_name || '|' || attribute_reference | stats distinctcount(fk) as findings by severity, finding_type | sort -findings
ask_ai_prompts: Which finding types and severities dominate, and which resources drive them?

widgets.name: Policy statement table
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | fields policy_name, policy_lifecycle_state, source_attribute, destination_attribute, network_scope, target_type, statement

widgets.name: Source destination matrix
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats distinctcount(statement) as rules by source_attribute, destination_attribute

widgets.name: Broad CIDR exceptions
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | fields severity, policy_name, cidr, recommendation
ask_ai_prompts: Which policies allow overly broad CIDR ranges?

widgets.name: Policy intent — modeled attribute relationships
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats distinctcount(statement) as rules by source_attribute, destination_attribute
widgets.description: Relationships modeled by collected policy statements. This is policy intent, not observed traffic.

widgets.name: Resources by attribute
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats distinctcount(resource_id) as resources by security_attributes

widgets.name: Resources by subnet
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats distinctcount(resource_id) as resources by subnet_id, resource_type

widgets.name: Resource detail
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | fields resource_name, resource_type, private_ip, subnet_id, security_attributes

widgets.name: Collector coverage by resource type
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_coverage' | stats count as resource_types by coverage_status

widgets.name: Explicit resource coverage gaps
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_coverage' and coverage_status != 'COLLECTED' | fields resource_type, coverage_status, inventory_snapshot_time, run_id

widgets.name: Flow Log actions and review classifications
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | eval fk = source_ip || '|' || destination_ip || '|' || destination_port || '|' || protocol | stats distinctcount(fk) as flows by action, review_classification
widgets.description: ACCEPT and REJECT are VCN Flow Log actions. Review classifications compare those observations with collected policy intent and are not provider ZPR verdicts.
ask_ai_prompts: Break down flows by action and classification over time.

widgets.name: Top observed flow pairs
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | stats distinctcount(flow_id) as unique_flow_ids by source_resource_name, destination_resource_name, source_ip, destination_ip | sort -unique_flow_ids
widgets.description: Counts distinct Flow Log flow IDs by resolved endpoint pair in the selected time range. Rows without a flow ID are not included in the count.
ask_ai_prompts: Which observed source and destination pairs have the most distinct flow IDs in this time range?

widgets.name: Flow IDs by protocol
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | stats distinctcount(flow_id) as unique_flow_ids by protocol | sort -unique_flow_ids
widgets.description: Counts distinct Flow Log flow IDs by recorded protocol in the selected time range. Rows without a flow ID are not included in the count.
ask_ai_prompts: How are distinct observed flow IDs distributed across recorded protocols in this time range?

widgets.name: Flow review trend
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | timestats span = 15min count by review_classification

widgets.name: Flow capture quality
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | stats count as flows by capture_status

widgets.name: Flow Log REJECTs to protected destinations
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' and zpr_destination = true | fields event_time, review_classification, correlation_confidence, zpr_attribution, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, source_port, destination_port, protocol, flow_id, bytes_out, packets, capture_status
widgets.description: Observed Flow Log REJECT records whose destination was attributed to a protected resource in the collected inventory. The rejecting control is not identified by this record.
ask_ai_prompts: Which Flow Log REJECT observations targeted resources identified as protected in the collected inventory?

widgets.name: Accepted flows requiring policy review
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and review_classification = 'accepted_requires_policy_review' | fields event_time, review_classification, correlation_confidence, zpr_attribution, correlation_reason, matched_policy_name, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, source_port, destination_port, protocol, flow_id, bytes_out, packets, capture_status
ask_ai_prompts: Which accepted flows lack an expected ZPR policy?

widgets.name: Observed paths — VCN Flow Logs
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | link source_resource_name, destination_resource_name, review_classification
widgets.description: Observed source-to-destination relationships from correlated VCN Flow Logs. This is separate from modeled policy intent and does not prove ZPR enforcement.
ask_ai_prompts: Trace observed VCN Flow Log paths from source to destination by review classification.

widgets.name: Policy drift candidates
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_drift' | fields event_time, change_type, policy_name, statement_index, old_statement, new_statement, old_hash, new_hash, run_id

widgets.name: Policy changes over time
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_drift' | timestats span = 15min count by change_type
widgets.description: Policy drift records emitted after successful snapshot comparisons, grouped by 15-minute event-time buckets. Choose a wider time range to explore history.

widgets.name: Missing policy findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'protected_resource_no_matching_policy' | fields severity, resource_name, resource_type, security_attributes, recommendation
ask_ai_prompts: Which protected resources have no matching ZPR policy?

widgets.name: DET: Accepted policy review
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and review_classification = 'accepted_requires_policy_review' | eval fk = source_ip || '|' || destination_ip || '|' || destination_port || '|' || protocol | stats distinctcount(fk) as accepted_for_review

widgets.name: DET: Rejected expected allow
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and review_classification = 'rejected_policy_expected_allow' | eval fk = source_ip || '|' || destination_ip || '|' || destination_port || '|' || protocol | stats distinctcount(fk) as rejected_expected_allow

widgets.name: DET: Flow Log REJECT to protected destination
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' and zpr_destination = true | eval fk = source_ip || '|' || destination_ip || '|' || destination_port || '|' || protocol | stats distinctcount(fk) as rejected_flow_tuples
widgets.description: Distinct observed Flow Log REJECT tuples to protected destinations. This does not identify the rejecting control.

widgets.name: DET: Broad CIDR exceptions
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | eval fk = policy_name || '|' || cidr | stats distinctcount(fk) as broad_cidr

widgets.name: Detection: accepted policy review (ZPR-Accepted-Review)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and review_classification = 'accepted_requires_policy_review' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Accepted-Review' | fields Detection, correlation_confidence, zpr_attribution, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol, flow_id

widgets.name: Detection: rejected expected allow (ZPR-Rejected-Expected-Allow)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and review_classification = 'rejected_policy_expected_allow' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Rejected-Expected-Allow' | fields Detection, correlation_confidence, zpr_attribution, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol, flow_id

widgets.name: Detection: Flow Log REJECT to protected destination
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' and zpr_destination = true | eval Detection = 'FLOW-REJECT-PROTECTED-DESTINATION' | fields Detection, correlation_confidence, zpr_attribution, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol

widgets.name: Detection: broad CIDR exceptions (ZPR-Broad-CIDR)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Broad-CIDR' | fields Detection, severity, policy_name, cidr, recommendation

widgets.name: Detection: policy drift (ZPR-Policy-Drift)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_drift' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Policy-Drift' | fields Detection, event_time, change_type, policy_name, old_statement, new_statement, old_hash, new_hash, run_id

widgets.name: Latest visibility runs
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_run' | fields event_time, run_id, schema_version, collection_status, flow_collection_status, record_count, finding_count, drift_count, flow_count, collection_error_count

widgets.name: Collector status
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_run' | stats count as runs by collection_status

widgets.name: Flow collection status
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_run' | stats count as runs by flow_collection_status

widgets.name: Collection gaps
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_collection_gap' | fields event_time, severity, collection_service, Operation, resource_type, Category, occurrence_count, recommendation, run_id

widgets.name: Resource coverage status
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_coverage' | stats count as resource_types by coverage_status

widgets.name: Schema versions observed
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | stats count as records by schema_version, record_type
